big_case.notes: Judge's own read, formed from the record before weighing the candidates' scores: a pro se participant's ERISA benefits dispute over the reading of 'may be reduced' in one North Carolina QDRO and the cost of a survivor annuity under one plan. One distribution, respondent waived, denied on the first order list after the long conference with no call for a response and no separate writing. Stakes confined to the parties.
